addDrive.title: Add Drive
addDrive.description: Enter your Cloudreve site URL to connect
addDrive.waitingDescription: Complete the sign-in process in your browser to connect your drive.
addDrive.finalSetupDescription: Choose a local folder to sync with your cloud drive. Files already in the folder will sync too.
addDrive.reauthorizeDescription: Click confirm to update your credentials for this drive.

errors.versionTooLow: Server version {{version}} is below minimum required {{minVersion}}
errors.stateMismatch: Authentication failed: state mismatch. Please try again.
errors.userIdMismatch: The account used for reauthorization does not match the original drive owner. Please sign in with the same account.

addDrive.browserUnavailable: The default browser could not be opened.

popup.scanRemoteChanges: Checking changed paths in the cloud
popup.upToDate: Your files are up to date.
popup.conflictContentsDiffer: Different here and in the cloud
popup.conflictDeletedLocally: Deleted here, changed in the cloud
popup.conflictDeletedInCloud: Deleted in the cloud, changed here
popup.conflictTypeMismatch: A file on one side and a folder on the other, or its parent is no longer a folder. Rename one to sync again.
popup.conflictUnsupportedItem: A link, special file, cloud item that isn't synced, or a name this computer can't store. It isn't synced.
popup.conflictNameCollision: Another item has the same name except for letter case or character form. Rename one to sync again.
popup.conflictDirectoryReplaced: This local folder was replaced by a different folder. It is paused so nothing is deleted by mistake.
popup.conflictCloudFolderReplaced: This cloud folder was replaced by a different folder. It is paused so nothing is deleted by mistake.
popup.conflictDirectoryNotEmpty: This folder was deleted on one side, but the other side still has new or changed items in it.
popup.conflictUncertainMove: A move or rename that couldn't be matched safely. It syncs again once both sides agree.
popup.conflictUploadInProgress: Another device is still uploading this file. Uploads left unfinished for a day are cleaned up automatically.
popup.conflictUnverifiedIdentity: Sync history from an older version isn't enough to apply this change safely.
popup.keepLocalUploadTip: Upload this computer's version over the cloud file.
popup.keepLocalTrashTip: Delete the cloud file too (moves it to the cloud trash).
popup.keepRemoteDownloadTip: Download the cloud version. The local version is moved to the recovery folder.
popup.keepRemoteRecoverTip: Accept the cloud deletion. The local file is moved to the recovery folder.
popup.keepBothTip: Keep the local version as a local-copy file, then download the cloud version.
